%c[ui_gray_2]Old wounds warm faintly near an artefact. You have learned to use that response to recover between patrols.

%c[ui_gray_3]Effects:
%c[ui_gray_2]- Healing artefacts restore permanent health to injured body parts.
- Each cycle restores 1 HP to each injured part. Stronger artefacts in better condition shorten the interval between cycles.
- Healing is twice as fast within 5 m of a lit campfire.

%c[d_red]Requires Body Health System. Special perk artefact effects require Perk-Based Artefacts. Each artefact still needs its usual conditions to work.%c[ui_gray_2]
